paragraphs: Hi! My name is Ben, and I am eleven years old. I love football. I like football more than basketball. I do not like basketball at all. I practice football every day after school. I do not practice on Sunday, because I help Dad at home. I have two balls, a red ball and a blue ball. I like the blue ball because it is new. I do not like the red ball because it is old. Last year I could not kick the ball to the goal. Now I can kick it to the goal every time. My football is always at the bottom of my bag.

I like animals, too. I like dolphins because they jump out of the water. I like penguins, too. I do not like sharks. They are very big, and they have many teeth. I do not have a pet at home. But I watch animal videos on my laptop. I like videos about whales. I do not like videos with loud music.

My friend Tom likes football, too. He is a good runner. But I kick the ball better than he does. Tom does not like animal videos. He says, "I like animals at the zoo, not on a laptop." We like different things, but we are good friends. "Shall we play football on Saturday?" asks Tom. "Yes, let's go!" I say. What sport do you like? What animals do you not like?
text.summary: Ben tells us about the sports and the animals that he likes and does not like. His friend Tom asks him to play football on Saturday.
